name: o3
description: Most advanced reasoning model with breakthrough performance on benchmarks.
longDescription: o3 is OpenAI's most capable reasoning model, achieving breakthrough results on math, science, and coding benchmarks. It uses an extended "chain of thought" process to think through complex problems before answering, delivering significantly improved accuracy on hard tasks.

codeSnippets.label: Python
codeSnippets.code:
import openai

client = openai.OpenAI()
response = client.chat.completions.create(
    model="o3",
    messages=[{"role": "user", "content": "Solve: What is the integral of x^2 * e^x dx?"}]
)
print(response.choices[0].message.content)
